headline: Wardens Retake Two Nevish Posts; Colonials Press On in Marban Hollow
war_summary: Two posts have passed back to Warden hands on the Nevish Line, trimming the Colonial share there to a single strongpoint of eight, yet the fighting only quickens — seventy flag actions logged in a day, Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal again the busiest grounds, two-hour losses near six hundred a side and climbing. In Marban Hollow the Colonials now hold six of eight strongpoints against one Warden, one ground in ruin, Checkpoint Bua again the center of the storm. In the Weathered Expanse every standing post now flies Warden colors, seven of seven with two grounds in ruin, the lone Colonial holding lost since our last edition, Crow's Nest the busiest ground there. Stlican Shelf remains hot, its losses heavy and fresh flag movement recorded at Briar; Linn Mercy cools by the hour, its flags last moving shortly before five, Lathair the busiest ground. Kuura Strand has gone nine hours without a flag turning despite rising casualty rolls. Fresh tremors marked this edition's hour at Transient Valley in Farranac Coast and The Reach in Stonecradle, while Callahans Passage and the Dead Lands grind on with mounting slaughter and no flags moved. It is day 709; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is declared.
